title: Bhakti Yoga
summary: Krishna explains that the path of personal devotion (Bhakti) is the swiftest and most direct way to attain Him, and lists the qualities of a devotee who is dear to Him.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
मय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते |
श्रद्धया परयोपेतास्ते मे युक्ततमा मताः || २ ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: Those who fix their minds on My personal form and are always engaged in worshipping Me with great and transcendental faith are considered by Me to be most perfect.
verses.transliteration:
śrī-bhagavān uvāca
mayy āveśya mano ye māṁ nitya-yuktā upāsate
śraddhayā parayopetās te me yuktatamā matāḥ
verses.meaning: Mayi - on Me; Aveshya - fixing; Manah - the mind...
